scientific_integrity: All polynomial congruences have exact finite certificates reconstructed by the embedded standard-library checker; the infinite result uses an exact formal-series argument. The bibliographic search has non-exhaustive coverage.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies representability only on four progressions modulo 64 and establishes an explicit obstruction set of density 1/32; it does not determine the entire exceptional set or its density.
title: Four Thue–Morse progressions of three-square obstructions for five-colored binary partitions
